items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: And Alcorn, this Alcorn boy, he was on tenor sax. And Sweet William was on the piano. Myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: Do you remember much about Oliver? Was he playing in New Orleans at the time?

No, Oliver left when I was a kid, but I do remember when he used to advertise, which we called Ballyhoo, and on a furniture wagon at that time. That was before the trunk. And I used to sit on a tailgate and give out the cyclists for the ball. So I come to know about Oliver.

Well, do you remember many of the trombones from that time? Well, no, I don't, I don't remember many of them. I mean, you spoke of Jack Carey, do you remember Ori? Was he playing down here then? No, he had left too, I think. Or, uh... Did you ever have anything to do with Professor Mineta, Manuel Mineta? Yeah, Old Horse they called him, eh? Yeah.
